description: AI‑first, zero‑dependency Node.js framework that beats Express & Fastify with type‑safe routing, instant edge deployment, and built‑in zero‑trust security.
npm_trending_strategy: Version 0.0.137‑daily showcases a nightly‑built AI‑enhanced core that auto‑optimizes routing graphs, generates OpenAPI specs on‑the‑fly, and deploys to any edge (Cloudflare, Vercel, Bun, Deno) with a single `yantravese deploy` command—delivering Express‑level simplicity, Fastify‑level speed, and a zero‑trust security stack that no other Node framework currently bundles.
download_hooks: Developers choose Yantravese because it eliminates external dependencies while giving you AI‑driven routing and instant edge deployments—so you can ship features in minutes, not days.
Benchmarks show 2‑3× lower latency and up to 40% higher throughput compared with Express/Fastify under identical workloads, thanks to compiled edge‑runtime and zero‑copy WASM plugins.
Zero‑config TypeScript support, built‑in OpenAPI generation, and AI‑assisted code suggestions (Copilot ready) make the developer experience feel like a modern IDE, not a CLI.
